channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Bayer to Invest $2.2 Billion in U.S. Pharma Manufacturing
item.description: Bayer announced plans to invest $2.2 billion in expanding its pharmaceutical manufacturing in the United States. The investment is intended for a new U.S. pharma site. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Lends $4.2 Billion to Vistra for Nuclear Power
item.description: The United States is set to provide a $4.2 billion loan to Vistra, an energy company, to increase its nuclear power generation capacity. The details of the loan were disclosed by a source to CNBC. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Tesla Aims for 10 Million Robots Annually, Supply Chain Implications Explored
item.description: Tesla has announced ambitions to produce 10 million robots annually, a goal that necessitates the development of a substantial supply chain. The company's plans involve significant expansion in manufacturing capabilities to support this… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Gas prices surge, prompting questions about electric vehicles
item.description: Gasoline prices have seen a significant increase, leading to discussions about the viability of purchasing electric cars. A quiz has been offered to help consumers consider this option. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold Prices Stabilize Ahead of US Jobs Report
item.description: Gold prices steadied as traders awaited the release of US payrolls data, with the precious metal on track for its second consecutive weekly loss. In parallel, US stock futures saw an advance ahead of the September payrolls report. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: China Probes European Chemical Imports Ahead of EU Talks
item.description: China has initiated an anti-dumping investigation into chemical imports originating from Europe. This action comes just days before scheduled talks between China and the European Union. The probe focuses on European chemical exports. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Dutch Eyewear Chain Halts Meta Glasses Sale Over Privacy Fears
item.description: The Dutch eyewear chain Hans Anders has stopped selling Meta glasses due to privacy concerns. The decision was reported by multiple outlets, highlighting the company's stance on data protection. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Chennai Port Launches Direct Container Service to Southeast Asia and China
item.description: Chennai Port has launched a new direct container service connecting it to Vietnam, Malaysia, and China. This initiative aims to facilitate smoother container movement and establish regular maritime connectivity between Chennai and Vietnam… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Chhattisgarh CM Bhupesh Baghel visits Singapore to attract investment
item.description: Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel has traveled to Singapore to present investment opportunities in the state to global investors. He is scheduled to participate in forums and roundtables, including a CEO roundtable, to discuss… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Public Sector Banks Show Strong Business Growth in Q2
item.description: Five public sector banks reported credit growth between 15% and 25% in the second quarter of the financial year 2027. This growth was driven by sustained demand for credit across agriculture, industry, services, and personal loans… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Mbappé Signs Deal with Sportswear Challenger On, Leaving Nike
item.description: Footballer Kylian Mbappé has signed a new deal with sportswear brand On, a challenger to Nike. Mbappé had been under contract with Nike for 20 years. This move marks On's entry into the football market. Reports suggest Nike has faced… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: G20 Nations Divided Over US Trade Proposals
item.description: During a G20 meeting, the United States faced pushback from other member nations regarding its proposals on excess industrial capacity and forced labor. These trade divisions have widened among the participating countries. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: India-US Trade Talks Focus on Interim Deal Ahead of Potential Modi-Trump Call
item.description: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal was scheduled to meet with US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to discuss the early conclusion of an interim trade agreement between the two countries. The talks come amid a US threat of 100%… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 8 · Right 1.

item.title: Nike Announces Job Cuts and Restructuring for Savings
item.description: Nike, the world's largest footwear company, is implementing a restructuring plan that includes job cuts and aims to achieve $2.5 billion in savings. The company is deepening its restructuring under CEO Elliott Hill to boost its turnaround… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Investors Shift Funds From France Amidst Growing Concerns
item.description: Investors are reportedly shifting capital away from France, with some directing funds towards Britain. This movement of investment comes as concerns about France's economic or political stability appear to be deepening, leading some… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Mortgage Rates Reach Near 3-Year High
item.description: US mortgage rates have climbed to their highest level in nearly three years. The increase has implications for potential homebuyers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: SEBI receives over 3,500 responses on Closing Auction Session changes
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has received over 3,500 responses to its consultation paper on changes to the Closing Auction Session (CAS) mechanism. SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated that the regulator plans to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Canada oil pipeline approval faces potential legal challenge
item.description: Mark Carney is aiming for final approval of a new Canadian oil pipeline by 2027, a move that faces potential legal challenges from First Nations groups. British Columbia Premier David Eby stated that his government has an important role to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Africa's Richest Man Launches Kenya Oil Refinery
item.description: Alhaji Aliko Dangote, described as Africa's richest man, has launched an oil refinery in Kenya. The refinery is part of a larger plan to industrialize Africa by 2030. The project involves a $300 million deal with US firm Honeywell and has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Fuel Prices Rise, Impacting Consumers and Businesses
item.description: Rising fuel prices are increasing costs for consumers and businesses, including charities. US refiners are reportedly experiencing windfall profits due to these escalating fuel costs, which are influenced by global conflicts. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Argentina Launches $350,000 Citizenship-by-Investment Program
item.description: Argentina has introduced a citizenship-by-investment program requiring a $350,000 investment. Nuri Katz, who helped develop the program, described it as a unique combination of a safe haven and a significant business opportunity… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sitharaman Calls for Resilience Amid Global Uncertainty
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that global uncertainty has become a permanent condition, necessitating policies designed to build resilience. She emphasized that this is an ongoing process, not a one-time exercise. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Private Capital Reshaping Sports and Entertainment Industries
item.description: Private capital is increasingly transforming the sports and entertainment industries, prompting a need for journalists to develop skills in financial forensics. This trend is evident in both sports and Hollywood moviemaking, indicating a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Egypt seeks deeper ties with India and Qatar for investment
item.description: Egypt is seeking to deepen economic ties with both India and Qatar. The country is navigating a pact related to Mecca while simultaneously aiming to increase its engagement with India. Concurrently, Egypt is pursuing Gulf investment in two… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold Prices Rise, Indian Equities Subdued Amid High Yields
item.description: Gold prices saw a rebound of 1.62 percent following recent downward pressure. Concurrently, Indian equities experienced subdued performance amidst elevated yield levels. The Aetram Group provided this analysis. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Phonex Group Chairman Gulam Ashraf Plans Business Expansion
item.description: Gulam Ashraf, Chairman of the Phonex Group, is planning business expansion across education, healthcare, and skill development sectors. The group is reportedly looking to broaden its existing initiatives in these areas. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Chemexcil Hosts 49th Export Awards Ceremony in Mumbai
item.description: The Basic Chemicals, Cosmetics & Dyes Export Promotion Council (Chemexcil) held its 49th Export Awards Ceremony in Mumbai. The event was organized to honor industry pioneers. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Goyal Meets US Firms' Officials Amid Trade Discussions
item.description: Union Minister Piyush Goyal held bilateral meetings with top officials from several US companies. The discussions focused on trade relations between the two nations. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: D-Mart Reports 18% Revenue Growth in Q2, Store Count Reaches 518
item.description: Avenue Supermarts, operating under the D-Mart brand, reported a year-on-year revenue increase of 18% for the second quarter of FY27, reaching ₹19,206.18 crore. The company's store count also expanded to 518 locations during this period. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian IT Sector Faces Slow Growth Amidst Cautious Spending
item.description: Indian IT companies are projected to experience muted growth in the first half of fiscal year 2027 (H1 FY27). Analysts anticipate only marginal growth due to persistent cautious spending by clients, ongoing macroeconomic risks, cost… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Mumbai Airport Terminal 1 Redevelopment Set for January 2027 Start
item.description: The redevelopment of Mumbai Airport's Terminal 1 is scheduled to commence in January 2027. This decision, according to Adani, is driven by safety concerns, which will lead to the partial shutdown of Terminal 1B from that date. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's Net Worth Surpasses $200 Billion
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's net worth has crossed $200 billion, making him the seventh-richest person globally. This surge is attributed to Nvidia's shares reaching a record high, driven by sustained demand for artificial intelligence chips… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: FAA finds Boeing 737 Max software glitch poses no safety risk
item.description: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has determined that a software glitch affecting certain flight computers on Boeing's 737 Max 10 aircraft does not pose a safety risk. This finding provides a boost to the certification process… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump Warns South Korea Over Alaska LNG Project
item.description: Former U.S. President Donald Trump has issued a warning to South Korea regarding an Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) project. Trump stated that South Korea should not proceed with the project without his approval, implying a potential… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Global food prices reach near four-year high in September
item.description: Global food prices have risen to their highest level in nearly four years, according to the United Nations' Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). The FAO Food Price Index averaged 136.0 points in September, an increase from a revised… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Energy suppliers warn of winter crisis, urge government action
item.description: Energy suppliers are warning of the worst winter energy crisis since 2022 and are urging the government to take immediate action to help households struggling with bills. Energy UK, a trade body, stated that immediate action is needed to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Federal Reserve likely to hold interest rates steady in October
item.description: The US Federal Reserve is likely to hold interest rates steady in October, with a top official signaling the central bank's intention. This potential pause comes as the US labor market shows signs of cooling more than anticipated… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Europe's Gas Storage Levels Raise Supply Shortage Fears
item.description: Europe's gas storage levels have reached 71% as winter approaches, sparking concerns about potential supply shortages and increased prices. Global gasoline prices are also expected to remain elevated due to ongoing supply constraints. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Adani Group Announces Rs 2.6 Trillion Projects in Maharashtra
item.description: Pranav Adani announced that the Adani Group has projects worth Rs 2.6 trillion completed or underway in Maharashtra. This statement was made at the 'Invest Maharashtra' launch event in Mumbai, where Adani stated, 'When Maharashtra Wins… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Gem & Jewellery Show Inaugurated by Industries Minister
item.description: Shri Uday Samant Ji, Cabinet Minister for Industries and Marathi Language, inaugurated the 10th edition of the India Gem & Jewellery Show (GJS 2026 Diwali Edition). The event is organized by the GJC. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
